STATUS: DONE

**What was changed:**

- **`file_tree.rs`**: Added `pub nerd_fonts: bool` to `FileTreeBuffer`. Changed `open()` signature to accept `nerd_fonts: bool`, stores it on the struct and passes it to `render_to_buffer`. Updated `toggle_at` to pass `self.nerd_fonts`. Rewrote `render_to_buffer` to call `icon_for_entry` and embed the glyph between marker and name. Fixed all 5 existing tests to pass `false`, added 2 new tests (`render_embeds_nerd_icon_in_rope`, `render_no_icon_when_nerd_fonts_disabled`).

- **`buffer_registry.rs`**: 6 test-only `FileTreeBuffer { ... }` struct literals all needed `nerd_fonts: false` added — they were not going through `open()` so the compiler caught them all.

- **`app.rs`** (line 12203): `FileTreeBuffer::open(&root)` → `FileTreeBuffer::open(&root, self.theme.nerd_fonts)`.

- **`render.rs`** (`draw_file_tree_pane`): Replaced the flat single-span loop with a `.enumerate().zip(tree.entries.iter()).skip(scroll).take(viewport)` chain that calls `icon_for_entry` per entry to get the color style, then composes `Modifier::REVERSED` on the cursor line on top of it.

**Surprise:** `buffer_registry.rs` had 6 additional `FileTreeBuffer` struct literal initializers in test fixtures (two separate test functions, not just one) that the task description didn't mention. They were straightforward to fix by adding `nerd_fonts: false`.

All 1118 tests pass.
